source_history: Monitoring Business Prepare alpha.1-alpha.14 + Risk Factor Passport draft.6-draft.7 dogfood handoffs

tests.lesson: Stale edge/removed node references must block before Editor.
Detached nodes/gates must block.
Declared external terminals need reachable incoming transitions.
Automatic/model/deterministic nodes must not contain human-input constructs such as question+answer_type or residual $answer.
Required model writes must be runtime-enforced, not metadata-only.
Human approval/signoff cannot depend on semantic recovery or structured $answer selectors.
Raw object/list/string state must not be transported via CLI argv; use materialized context snapshots.
Deterministic RUN writes evidence; separate GATE decides.
Declared deliverables must be materialized on reachable control flow.
Auto Answers ZIP must match Editor replay package shape.
Editor candidate must be source-only with respect to Editor compilation.
Fail-closed free-text retries must mutate observable attempt/progress state.
Revision registries/matrices/evidence must update atomically and retain full revision records.
Factory must ship canonical safe profiles for automatic model, deterministic RUN/GATE, human enum/free-text, materialization, package and terminal nodes.
Vibe and Editor-facing gates need one machine-readable compatibility protocol.
Candidate must not be exposed as analyst-ready until all trusted regressions and smoke checks pass.
Generated contract validator must be a registered Vibe-owned runner.
Every generated playbook verification profile must include the blocking generated-playbook contract.
The Vibe factory must continuously execute this regression memory on itself.
The authoring verification rail must explicitly use the contract validator, safe profiles and Editor compatibility protocol.
Review/acceptance/handoff must not expose candidates while the generated contract is failing.
Portable immutable manifest must be complete for alpha20 assets, exclude generated bytecode, and match file hashes/sizes atomically.
Canonical support provenance manifest must resolve every effective path and match the effective hash/size; local effective changes must never leave stale support hashes.
User-facing entry documents and compatibility evidence must identify the actual candidate revision and must not falsely claim an accepted baseline.
Static route words such as block are not implicit terminals; only declared targets or canonical reserved STOP may close a route.
Explicit deterministic package-tool responsibilities need tool identity, declared effect/output, and an explicit route before simulation.
Archive/package outputs must declare required membership rather than relying on prose or runtime inference.
Archive/package outputs require structured member/archive hash evidence or an explicit deterministic dynamic hash validation contract.
A declared post-materialization validation requirement must name a deterministic validator.
Factory static completeness gates should catch generated deterministic profile gaps before invoking the pinned runtime simulation; simulation remains the fail-closed backstop.
A derivable field must be resolved from canonical rules rather than materialized as UNKNOWN.
Missing data must not be converted to analyst-confirmed UNKNOWN without structural provenance.
Every substantive template section needs a canonical/source/derived/optional/downstream resolution strategy.
Semantic quality review may return structured findings but must not mutate canonical state or override deterministic failures.
Generated tests must be rule-linked with concrete inputs/preconditions and expected outcomes; fixed row counts are not quality.
Derivable defects self-repair before analyst escalation; source, analyst and downstream findings route distinctly.
Generated playbooks with strict runtime targets prove terminal semantics in Model Mode first and preserve that trace as the runtime equivalence oracle.
Partial node output must merge by diff and preserve unrelated state.
A node that becomes current again must execute even if it was historically visited or answered.
Gate FAIL with declared on_fail must enter the recovery route rather than terminal block.
Business/Data-Layer fields must not be invented solely to compensate for CLI/runner defects.
Simultaneously visible consequential human decisions from the same information group are discovered before asking.
Stable decision ids preserve partial answers and prevent re-asking resolved decisions without new conflict.
Recovery behavior must be tested end to end from validation FAIL through repair/rematerialization to PASS while preserving unrelated state and resolved authority.
